behaviorChanges: the validate workflow publishes a run artifact named `evidence` containing a tautline-evidence/v1 document with one `eval` result per gate the job runs (methodology suite, CLI compile, validate.sh freeze-check, whitespace); every gate still blocks the build exactly as before

optionalMigrations.description: Adopters can compose the same tautline-evidence/v1 conformance document from their own validate/gate job with .github/scripts/emit_evidence.py, so their validate stage renders real per-gate pass/fail counts on the CommandCenter dashboard.

requiredMigrations.command: gh auth refresh --hostname github.com -s read:project -s project
requiredMigrations.description: Carried forward from 0.10.3 for lanes updating across it: grant the gh token the GitHub Projects scopes the fail-closed board gates need. Machines already on 0.10.3+ or whose token carries read:project and project need no action.

rollbackNotes: Pinning back to 0.10.12 stops the validate workflow from publishing its `evidence` artifact; the four gates and their blocking behavior are unchanged either way (the evidence surface is purely additive reporting). No on-disk state moves.
